summary: Faz 10 offboarding-on-company-change UI flow verified end-to-end. Created QA_A/QA_B companies, qa_mgr/qa_emp (with lifetime license), one PENDING and one DONE task assigned to qa_emp in QA_A. Logged in as admin serkan/19071987 via UI, opened Settings → Users, clicked admin-company-{qa_emp} button, selected QA_B chip, clicked Save. PATCH /api/admin/users/<id> returned 200 with _offboard={archived:1, orphaned:1, manager_id:<qa_mgr_id>}. UI displayed the success toast: 'qa_emp_242159 → QA_B_242159 · 1 görev müdüre aktarıldı, 1 biten görev arşive taşındı'. Logged out, logged in as qa_mgr_<sfx>/pass1234. NotificationBell badge=1, popover rendered the tasks_orphaned row with package icon and text '📦 qa_emp_242159 ayrıldı — 1 görev size aktarıldı · tıkla ▶'. Clicking the notification's inner button switched the sidebar to tab-orphans (border-sertex-cyan text-sertex-cyan class applied) and the Yarım Kalan panel showed '1 YARIM KALAN GÖREV' with QA_PENDING_242159 (owner qa_emp_242159, company QA_A_242159, '28 Tem den beri sahipsiz', 'BAŞKA ÇALIŞANA DEVRET' button). Switching to tab-tasks (Görevler) confirmed QA_PENDING_242159 also appears in the manager's normal task list (assigned to QA_MGR_242159, company QA_A_242159), while QA_DONE_242159 is NOT present (archived). All 5 requested acceptance criteria PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: NotificationBell.jsx: the data-testid `notification-item-{id}` is on an outer <div>, but the onClick handler is on the inner <button>. Tests that click the item via its testid do nothing unless they target the inner button. Not a user-facing bug (real users click on the visible text which is inside the button), but consider hoisting onClick to the div or adding a data-testid on the button for easier automation.
